name: app-floating-tilted-phones-under-giant-crack-headline
title: Two Floating Phones under a Giant Headline
whatItIs: A cream slide with a giant black word 'Crack' cropped behind two floating tilted phones, one dark with a purple plan form and one light with a stacked block schedule, a thin vertical line and a small caption.
whatItMeans: Oversized type and floating devices feel bold and playful, and the block visual makes planning tangible.
techniques: Two phones in dark and light versions
Block-stack visualisation as a signature graphic
Soft floor shadow beneath floating devices
One thin vertical line for structure

vocabulary.definition: A device shown in mid-air with a soft shadow below.
Large type partially covered by objects.
Two themes of the same UI shown together.
